hypothesis: One of the five alternative training objectives (supervised contrastive, pairwise AUC surrogate, hard-example mining, noise-robust GCE, weight EMA) lifts the canonical FT-Transformer's route-view fold-0 signal enough that its equal-logit blend with route_ref beats route_ref by >= +5e-5 AUC with Spearman < 0.995 -- i.e. the batch-1 neural screens' weakness was the BCE objective, not the architecture/representation.
why_distinct: Batch-1/2 screened 19 ARCHITECTURES, all under plain BCE. This batch holds architecture + config + seed FIXED (canonical FT-Transformer, frozen batch-1 hyperparameters, seed 1) and varies only the training OBJECTIVE/sampling, so any fold-0 delta is attributable to the objective alone. A control-parity arm (plain BCE through the new code path) must reproduce the committed batch-1 result (AUC 0.957656) to validate code-path equivalence before variants are interpreted.

model_card.architecture: FT-Transformer (Gorishniy et al. 2021) from src/phase20/neural_arch.py, frozen batch-1 config: d_token=192, n_layers=3, n_heads=8, dropout=0.1, head_hidden=192
model_card.training_config: lr=1e-3, weight_decay=1e-5, batch_size=4096, max_epochs=100, es_patience=15, AdamW + 5-epoch linear warmup + cosine, bf16 autocast, inner-val AUC early stopping

variants.bce_control: plain BCEWithLogits (exact batch-1 objective) through the new runner -- parity arm; must reproduce control AUC within 1e-4 or the batch is void
variants.supcon: BCE + 0.5 * SupCon on a 128-d linear projection of the CLS embedding, temperature 0.1, FIT-train labels only (OBJ37)
variants.auc_surrogate: pure pairwise RankNet surrogate: mean softplus(-(z_pos - z_neg)) over 4096 sampled (pos,neg) FIT-train pairs per step; no BCE anchor (OBJ38)
variants.hard_mining: dynamic hard-example mining: per-sample BCE EMA hardness maintained on FIT-train only; each batch drawn 50% from current top-20% hardest, 50% uniform (OBJ39; not a fixed reweight -- hardness re-estimated every epoch)
variants.gce: generalized cross-entropy noise-robust loss, p=0.7: mean((1 - p_t^0.7)/0.7) (OBJ40)
variants.ema: plain BCE training; exponential moving average of weights (decay 0.999) used for inner-val evaluation AND final prediction (OBJ41)

decision_rule.frozen_rule: PROMISING iff port_delta >= +5e-5 AND spearman_vs_route_ref < 0.995 (per variant; any variant may pass)
decision_rule.port_delta: AUC(equal-logit blend(variant, route_ref)) - AUC(route_ref) on primary fold-0 (all 139927 rows)
decision_rule.parity_gate: bce_control must land within 1e-4 of the committed control AUC 0.9576563038026185 or NO variant is interpreted

anti_leakage: train on FIT only (folds 1-4); inner 10% ES split carved from FIT only; fold-0 labels read only at final metrics
supcon/hard_mining use FIT-TRAIN labels only (training labels, never val or eval labels) for projections/hardness
route view is label-free (raw21 + coarse10, no target encoding)
scaler fit on FIT-train only; EMA touches no labels at all
champion fold-0 references hash-asserted via load_champion_fold0; route_ref from the OOF store

protocol.view: route (22 features via frames(tr, te, route=True))
protocol.fit_rows: all primary FIT rows (folds 1-4); inner 10% ES from FIT only (seed 1)
protocol.eval: all primary fold-0 rows (139927), bounded inference minibatch 65536
protocol.run_order: bce_control first (parity gate), then supcon, auc_surrogate, hard_mining, gce, ema; each arm writes its own report; a crashed arm does not block others
